title: frangula tomentella
intro: Frangula tomentella, commonly known as the Rough Buckthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of diarrhea, dysentery, and other gastrointestinal issues due to its anti-inflammatory and astringent effects. The therapeutic actions of Frangula tomentella are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as anthraquinone glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
